name: MASVS-Bench
description: MASVS-Bench is a manually validated benchmark for evaluating automated Android security compliance assessment against the OWASP Mobile Application Security Verification Standard (MASVS). The benchmark was constructed from 480 real-world open-source Android applications. Static analysis identified 800 candidate security cases, which were subsequently reviewed manually against the corresponding MASVS requirements and implementation evidence. The released benchmark contains 599 cases with definitive verdicts from 331 applications, including 197 confirmed violations and 402 confirmed non-violations. It spans ten MASVS controls across six control groups. Each benchmark case includes its MASVS mapping, implementation evidence and location, validation verdict, and supporting rationale, while confirmed violations additionally include remediation guidance. The release includes `benchmark.csv` containing the validated cases and `applications.csv` containing application-level metadata. MASVS-Bench is intended to support research on automated security compliance assessment, including compliance classification, evidence grounding, explanation quality, remediation recommendation, and false-assurance analysis.
